scenarios.title: A private hire on a shared table with a PAID seat is refused; the seat and its charge untouched

checks.desc: a shared seat is booked, paid and confirmed
the session is a shared table (private=false), 1 seat taken
the private hire is REFUSED with 409
the message says the time is a shared table
checks.detail: That time is already a shared table — choose another for a private hire.

checks.desc: the shared seat is untouched (still 1, still shared)
STRIPE: the paid seat’s charge is intact — captured, £0 refunded

scenarios.title: A cancelled private booking refunds, frees the room, and the time reopens as a shared table

checks.desc: the time is a private hire (private=true), full at 1/1
cancel returns a refund
STRIPE: the private booking was refunded in full (£120)
the room is freed (seats back to 0)
the same time now takes a SHARED booking (reopened as either)
the session re-established as a shared table (private=false, capacity 8)

scenarios.title: A cancelled seat frees only itself; the other paid guest stays, the table stays shared, private still refused

checks.desc: the shared table has 3 seats taken
cancelling the 2-seat order refunds
STRIPE: only the cancelled order was refunded (£60)
only the 2 seats freed — 1 remains (nothing freed a paid seat)
the table is still shared (private=false)
STRIPE: the remaining guest’s charge is intact — captured, £0 refunded
the remaining guest’s order is still confirmed
a private hire is still refused while a guest is seated
